name: vision-spring-playwright
description: Vision Spring Playwright Test Automation Framework

scripts.report:file-processing: npm run allure:clean-results && playwright test tests/FileProcessing --reporter=allure-playwright && npm run allure:normalize-results && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report-fileprocessing && node scripts/customize-allure-report.js allure-report-fileprocessing
scripts.report:file-processing:portable: allure generate allure-results --clean --single-file -o allure-report-fileprocessing-single && node scripts/customize-allure-report.js allure-report-fileprocessing-single
scripts.report:file-processing:all: npm run allure:clean-results && playwright test tests/FileProcessing --reporter=allure-playwright && npm run allure:normalize-results && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report-fileprocessing && node scripts/customize-allure-report.js allure-report-fileprocessing && npx allure generate allure-results --clean --single-file -o allure-report-fileprocessing-single && node scripts/customize-allure-report.js allure-report-fileprocessing-single
scripts.report:customer-module-management: npm run allure:clean-results && playwright test tests/CustomerModuleManagement --reporter=allure-playwright && npm run allure:normalize-results && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report-customer-module-management && node scripts/customize-allure-report.js allure-report-customer-module-management
scripts.report:customer-module-management:portab: npx allure generate allure-results --clean --single-file -o allure-report-customer-module-management-single && node scripts/customize-allure-report.js allure-report-customer-module-management-single
scripts.report:combined:parallel: npm run allure:clean-results && playwright test tests/FileProcessing tests/CustomerModuleManagement --workers=2 --reporter=allure-playwright && npm run allure:normalize-results && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report-combined && node scripts/customize-allure-report.js allure-report-combined
scripts.report:combined:parallel:portable: npx allure generate allure-results --clean --single-file -o allure-report-combined-single && node scripts/customize-allure-report.js allure-report-combined-single
scripts.report:combined:share: npm run allure:clean-results && playwright test tests/FileProcessing tests/CustomerModuleManagement --workers=2 --reporter=allure-playwright && npm run allure:normalize-results && npx allure generate allure-results --clean --single-file -o allure-report-combined-shareable && node scripts/customize-allure-report.js allure-report-combined-shareable
